description: This is a Java test class for the implementation of PatientService in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for the PatientServiceImpl class. The tests verify behaviors such as handling identifiers, detecting duplicates, and processing patient death.

classes.name: PatientServiceImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PatientServiceImpl, testing various scenarios such as identifier validation, duplicate detection, and death processing.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializing the PatientServiceImpl instance and mocking dependencies.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldThrowMissingRequiredIdentifierGivenRequiredIdentifierTypeMissing
methods.description: Tests that missing required patient identifiers throw a MissingRequiredIdentifierException.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldNotThrowMissingRequiredIdentifierGivenRequiredIdentifierTypesArePresent
methods.description: Ensures no exception is thrown when all required identifiers are present.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldThrowDuplicateIdentifierGivenDuplicateIdentifiers
methods.description: Checks that duplicate identifiers of the same type cause a DuplicateIdentifierException.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldThrowInsufficientIdentifiersErrorGivenPatientHasNoActiveIdentifiers
methods.description: Verifies that patients with only voided identifiers trigger an InsufficientIdentifiersException.

methods.name: checkPatientIdentifiers_shouldIgnoreAbsenceOfActiveIdentifiersGivenPatientIsVoided
methods.description: Confirms that voided patients without active identifiers do not raise an exception.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldThrowErrorGivenEmptyAttributes
methods.description: Tests that an empty list of attributes throws an APIException.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldThrowErrorGivenNoAttributes
methods.description: Tests that null attribute list throws an APIException.

methods.name: getDuplicatePatientsByAttributes_shouldCallDaoGivenAttributes
methods.description: Ensures the DAO method is called when valid attributes are provided and returns expected results.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypes_shouldReturnPatientIdentifierTypesFromDao
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of patient identifier types from DAO given search parameters.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypes_shouldReturnEmptyListGivenDaoReturnsNull
methods.description: Checks that null DAO response yields an empty list.

methods.name: processDeath_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfPatientIsNull
methods.description: Confirms that passing null patient throws an APIException.

methods.name: processDeath_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfDateDiedIsNull
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown if death date is null.

methods.name: processDeath_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfCauseOfDeathIsNull
methods.description: Checks for exception if cause of death is null.

methods.name: processDeath_shouldMapValuesAndSavePatient
methods.description: Tests that processing death maps relevant fields and saves the patient correctly.
